exposure: energy source (Harmonic Ace Shears or monopolar/bipolar electro-surgery)
cohort: 1876 gynecologic patients who underwent endoscopic hysterectomy with either barbed or vicryl running sutures.
finding: No cases of vaginal cuff dehiscence were observed following laparoscopic hysterectomy performed with barbed suture closure, while nearly all observed cases were associated with robotic-assisted hysterectomy involving vicryl sutures.
